name: antigravity-proxy-helper
description: Windows per-app proxy helper for Antigravity: auto-detects local HTTP/mixed proxy ports (Clash, Mihomo, v2rayN, sing-box, etc.) and auto-repairs shortcuts after updates without modifying system proxy.
suggestedPrompts: Check my local proxy port and Antigravity shortcut status
Install or repair Antigravity auto-proxy shortcuts
Switch Antigravity proxy helper to manual port or restore defaults
